requirements.requirement: A valid preselected consent profile binds one synthetic endpoint and one synthetic region before remote work begins.
Absent, stale, expired or revoked profile fails closed before any request.
Route, network type and VPN state never select, switch or migrate endpoint or region.
Local-first workflows remain usable and nonblocking without account, network, GMS or cloud configuration.
Every mutating logical operation uses a stable content-free idempotency key bound to its canonical request digest and scope.
Create, init-or-refresh, upload part, complete, poll, result, cancel, delete and deletion-receipt operations form one versioned lifecycle.
Every part and the complete artifact bind exact byte length and SHA-256; manifest order and contiguous part ordinals are mandatory.
Resume reconciles durable server receipts and uploads only missing parts.
Expired part URLs refresh only the upload plan generation while preserving job, upload, profile, endpoint and region.
Retries are finite, battery-safe, process-death-safe and classified; Retry-After never overrides remaining attempt or elapsed budgets.
Lost responses and duplicate requests replay one canonical outcome without a second resource or economic effect.
A successful logical workflow commits one job, exactly one result and exactly one synthetic economic event, with zero duplicates.
Cancellation resolves deterministically against completion/result commit order and never creates a second terminal effect.
Delete remains independently pending until one verifiable deletion receipt is returned; repeats do not create another deletion.
Logs and evidence are content-free and exclude payload bytes, text, URLs, object keys, IP addresses, tokens, credentials and raw idempotency keys.
Fake and loopback evidence is contract-layer evidence only and cannot be reported as physical device, VPN, route, provider or production PASS.

consentProfile.digestRule: profileBindingSha256 is SHA-256 of DORA-CJ-v1 over every listed field except profileBindingSha256.
consentProfile.validityRule: Present, schema-valid, artifact/purpose exact, now in [issuedAt, expiresAt), revokedAt null, endpoint allowlisted and endpoint/region equal every persisted job binding.
consentProfile.failureRule: Missing, stale, expired, revoked, malformed or mismatched profile produces FINAL_REJECT before transport and no endpoint fallback.
consentProfile.routeRule: DNS result, interface, Wi-Fi/cellular transition and VPN state cannot mutate endpointId or regionCode.

canonicalization.name: DORA-CJ-v1
canonicalization.jsonRule: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted by Unicode code point; array order preserved; strings JSON-escaped; integers base-10 without leading zero; lowercase true/false/null; floats forbidden; no insignificant whitespace.
canonicalization.requestDigestRule: SHA-256(UTF8(contractId + LF + method + LF + routeTemplate + LF + operationClass + LF + profileBindingSha256 + LF + bodyDescriptor)).
canonicalization.jsonBodyDescriptor: DORA-CJ-v1(request body after removal of volatile fields).
canonicalization.immutableIdRule: All server IDs are opaque, content-free and immutable; evidence may contain IDs but no user/content-derived component.
canonicalization.logKeyRule: Evidence stores SHA-256 of an idempotency key, never the raw key.

idempotencyContract.sameKeySamePayload: Return the original application status and canonical response digest, identical resource IDs and identical economic effect; set Idempotency-Replayed=true after the first response.
idempotencyContract.sameKeyDifferentPayload: Return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH; create no resource, state transition, receipt or economic effect.
idempotencyContract.lostResponseReplay: Replay the same key and canonical request digest; recover the committed canonical outcome without issuing a new logical operation.
idempotencyContract.duplicateCompletion: Return the original 202 response and commitId; do not enqueue twice or create another result/economic effect.
idempotencyContract.repeatedDelete: The same logical delete returns the same deletionId and eventual deletionReceiptId. A new key for an already deleted fixture also resolves to the same deletion record without a second delete effect.
idempotencyContract.crossTenantOrProfile: Never reuse or migrate a record. Return non-enumerating 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_AUTHORIZED and create no effect.
idempotencyContract.sameKeyDifferentOperationClass: A different operationClass is a distinct scope, but clients still generate a fresh key to avoid ambiguous diagnostics.
idempotencyContract.durabilityBoundary: A future hermetic server must durably commit idempotency record, resource state and synthetic economic effect atomically and preserve them across injected process death for the entire authorized run.

multipartContract.partNumbers: Contiguous integers 1..N in the completion manifest.
multipartContract.arrivalOrder: Part arrival may differ from manifest order.
multipartContract.sizeRule: Every part except the last is exactly partSizeBytes; the last is in (0, partSizeBytes].
multipartContract.checksumRule: Server verifies received byte length and SHA-256 before committing one immutable part receipt.
multipartContract.samePartReplay: Same uploadId, partNumber, byteLength and SHA-256 returns the same partReceiptId.
multipartContract.partMismatch: Same uploadId and partNumber with different byteLength or SHA-256 returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH and cannot replace the committed part.
multipartContract.completionRule: Missing, duplicated or noncontiguous ordinals, wrong sizes, wrong part digests or wrong overall byte length/SHA-256 return 422 and never enter UPLOAD_COMPLETE or processing.
multipartContract.resumeRule: Client reconciles server part receipts after reconnect or process death and sends only missing parts.
multipartContract.refreshRule: An expired URL creates a new plan generation and new operation key while preserving jobId, uploadId, profile binding, endpoint and region. Old URLs remain invalid.
multipartContract.urlEvidenceRule: Part URLs and tokens are never written to evidence or logs.

outcomeInvariants.expression: committedResultCount in {0,1} always and == 1 after successful processing
syntheticEconomicEffectCount == 1 after first logical job commit
endpointId and regionCode equal the preselected consent profile for the entire logical workflow
verifiedDeletionReceiptCount in {0,1} always and == 1 after successful delete

syntheticEconomicOracle.commitBoundary: Atomically with the first logical CREATE_JOB commit.

rules: Every retry preserves logical operation key and canonical request digest except REFRESH_UPLOAD_PLAN, which uses a new plan-generation key while preserving upload identity and profile binding.
No busy loop: persist nextAttemptAt from a monotonic clock and wake only for a due attempt with valid profile and required network condition.
Retry-After is honored only when valid and within both remaining attempt and elapsed budgets; absent, malformed or excessive values use bounded local policy or exhaust safely.
No attempt occurs after maxAttempts or maxElapsedMs; exhaustion is FAILED_FINAL until explicit user action creates a new logical workflow.
TLS trust/name, consent profile, schema, endpoint/region, checksum, authorization and idempotency-payload mismatch failures are FINAL_REJECT or USER_ACTION_REQUIRED and never silently retried.
This contract defines no production timeout, SLA, provider quota or tariff.

arbitration.withinGroupOrder: The listed transitionIds are an exact secondary order; the first eligible transition wins.
arbitration.selectionRule: For one durable state/event snapshot, filter to transitions whose explicit from set contains the current state and whose guard is true; select the eligible transition with the lowest numeric priority, then the earliest listed transitionId in that priority group. Select at most one transition and persist its event, priority and transitionId atomically with the state change.
arbitration.noEligibleTransitionRule: Persist a content-free NO_STATE_CHANGE observation and retain the current state.
arbitration.terminalPreservationRule: DELETED and FAILED_FINAL have no outgoing transitions. CANCELLED ignores profile-invalid and automatic events and permits only explicit VPN-C-TR-042 when the profile is valid.

terminalSemantics.DELETED: Absorbing terminal state for this logical workflow.
terminalSemantics.FAILED_FINAL: Absorbing terminal state for this logical workflow; a new explicit workflow creates a new FSM instance and keys.
terminalSemantics.CANCELLED: Durably settled and non-retryable, but not deletion-terminal; only a later explicit valid-profile delete may enter DELETE_PENDING.

clientStateMachine.processDeathRule: On restart, validate profile, load the last checksum-protected state/operation ledger, reconcile server receipts using the same keys, and restore exactly that state or its WAITING_NETWORK/RETRY_SCHEDULED wrapper. Never reset to READY or create a new job implicitly.
clientStateMachine.localNonblockingRule: Every remote transition is durable queued work. Local capture, local processing, local browse/search/export and access to an existing local result continue independently.

transitions.guard: complete ordered manifest and overall digest

serverStateMachine.atomicityRule: The first CREATE_JOB commit atomically persists idempotency record, job, binding and one synthetic economic event. Each later commit atomically persists its idempotency record, state change and receipt/result/deletion effect.
serverStateMachine.processDeathRule: Restart reloads durable state and ledgers; it never reconstructs a second job, part, completion, result, deletion or economic event.

terminalSemantics.DELETED: Absorbing terminal state for the remote lifecycle.
terminalSemantics.CANCELLED: Durably settled with no processing retry, but eligible for one later explicit DELETE_COMMIT into DELETE_PENDING.

transitionTraces.preconditions: RESULT_AVAILABLE; stable job/profile/endpoint/region; same result fetch operation; one retry attempt remains.
transitionTraces.expected: Same job/profile/endpoint/region and result operation are preserved; at most one committed result exists.

transitionTraces.name: IMMEDIATE_FINAL_REJECT_FAMILIES
transitionTraces.expected: Every case reaches FAILED_FINAL in one transition and visits neither WAITING_NETWORK nor RETRY_SCHEDULED.

transitionTraces.name: CANCEL_THEN_EXPLICIT_DELETE

transitionTraces.expected: Explicit source sets preserve settled/terminal states; lower numeric priority and listed secondary order select exactly one transition.

preflightChecks.check: Exact contract commit/tree and artifact SHA-256 are recorded.
Markdown/JSON semantic parity, strict JSON and all unique contiguous ID ranges pass.
Separate execution and measured-execution authority is present.
Every positive finite execution-profile parameter and deterministic seed is frozen.
Fixture manifest contains only the seven bounded synthetic fixtures and exact digests.
Consent profile is present, current, unrevoked and bound to one allowlisted synthetic endpoint/region.
Harness mode is explicitly allowed; loopback server is verified loopback-only with no external bind.
Fault schedule lists only VPN-FLT-001..034 before start and manual mutation is disabled.
Client/server clocks, schedulers and fault-order seeds are deterministic.
Idempotency, state and economic ledgers begin empty or match an explicitly resumed attempt.
Content-free logger rejects every forbidden field before evidence persistence.
Evidence retention destination and TTL are separately approved.
No credentials, provider account, billing instrument, real endpoint or real data is configured.
Proof label is limited to TRANSPORT_FAKE or HERMETIC_LOOPBACK and excludes device/VPN/provider/production PASS.

resultTaxonomy.INCONCLUSIVE: A valid attempt exists but its evidence scope or completeness cannot decide every applicable contract predicate.
resultTaxonomy.PASS: A valid future attempt satisfies every applicable frozen predicate; the label must include its bounded proof class.
resultTaxonomy.FAIL: A valid future attempt violates at least one applicable frozen invariant.
resultTaxonomy.INVALID_ATTEMPT: A run matches any VPN-INV-001..012 condition and cannot influence PASS/FAIL.
